The '''2012–13 San Diego State men's basketball team''' represented [[San Diego State University]] in the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2012–13]] [[college basketball]] season. They were members in the [[Mountain West Conference]]. This was head coach [[Steve Fisher (American basketball coach)|Steve Fisher]]'s fourteenth season at San Diego State. The Aztecs played home games at [[Viejas Arena]]. They finished with a record of 23–11 overall, 9–7 in Mountain West play for 3rd place tie with [[2012–13 Boise State Broncos men's basketball team|Boise State]]. They lost in the semifinals in the [[2013 Mountain West Conference men's basketball tournament]] to [[2012–13 New Mexico Lobos men's basketball team|New Mexico]]. They received an at-large bid in the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]], in which they beat [[2012–13 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|Oklahoma]] in the second round and lost in the third round to [[2012–13 Florida Gulf Coast Eagles men's basketball team|Florida Gulf Coast]].
